profile.headline: Software Engineer at Client of: Black Diamond Networks
profile.summary:
Software Developer with over 20 years of experience in languages and application development, mostly for Windows environment. Strong skills in problem solving and UI design. Good communication skills. Team oriented with ability to learn quickly. Self-taught, self-starter that is able to work independently.

Seeking a position in a team environment. Seeking to work with modern development languages such as C#. Would like to work more with user interface coding. Would prefer to work for a company with focused product suite. Ideally in the Waltham area.

Knowledge Assessments:
    http://www.brainbench.com/, Transcript #9021246
    http://smarterer.com/eniblack/

Windows 8/7/Vista/XP/2000, NT 4.0 and 3.51, C++ language, C++ library. C language, C library. C# language. PowerShell. HTML, XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, AngularJS. XML, XSLT, SVG, Microsoft C# .NET 2012/2010/2008/2005/2003. Microsoft C# ASP.NET.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Started by working on main website for 5 months. Took over beginnings of webapp, which is to replace the current control panel. Uses AngularJS 1. Added build using gulp. Converted CSS to SCSS and HTML to pug/jade to allow better code building. Added central logging feature. Added pre-processor to manage build types. Reworked protractor E2E tests sources to reside next to sources. Reworked all tests to build to match build type (debug has more detailed testing of private functions).

Developed api-mock to ease app development. Allow control over data and return statuses. It is a REST interface mimicking the real one, plus a UI to set the response conditions (forced error and response with optional delay).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: 6-month contract to initially work on finishing existing version of an enterprise UI product using Silverlight and Web API w/JetBrains ReSharper. Extended my contract three times. Worked on issues assigned to me in JIRA, starting work, finishing and assigning to QA. Update documentation in Confluence with rich formatting. Daily morning Scrum meeting. Later, worked the next UI product version using HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript using AngualrJS, JetBrains WebStorm. Added a Web API to centralized logging into the database. The logs came from both the server-side we well as the HTML client. Created a PowerShell build script to unify all JS files in a module into one file and optionally minify them (release). Added to the build process internationalization using angular-gettext to the source structure and build process. Build automatically creates output directory for POT files to be sent for translation. Added to the build process native support for building LESS files and ignoring variable/mixin definition files. Built unit tests using Karma with Jasmine. Consulted Karma Coverage for completeness. Used Crucible to participate in code reviews. Refactored initial HTML/CSS files for better display on other full-sized browsers. The company expressed a desire for me to stay full-time, but I declined.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: 6-month contract to help, as directed, building the next generation equipment controlling application with elaborate user interface. Created new WPF screens. Helped modify existing WPF screens. Added bar graph to one screen using WPF Toolkit. Used .NET reflection to create a means to calling back into code for use by custom script. Aided in developing the sequences to move cassettes through the robot. Created a separate process to read analog data from a laser distance reader and perform analysis on the data. Created a separate application for use by the imaging group. Added/improved entry validation on screens using built-in WPF validation system.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Took over maintenance of existing test application for a major maker's proprietary phone OS. Wrote new custom application to make more flexible, portable, and usable by testers. Coded in sections for maximum portability. Reference ports to Windows and Linux. Platform port to major maker's proprietary OS. Helped developers with new portable engine periodically by coding logging many defects and enhancement suggestions and coding fixes.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Sophelle is a leading IT consultancy focused on helping major retail organizations plan and implement technology solutions. 

See my website for a detailed resume.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Nuance (formerly ScanSoft) develops award-winning document automation solutions, including OCR, eForm design, personal document management applications and speech products. Lernout & Hauspie developed award-winning speech and language products, including VoiceExpress and Dragon NaturallySpeaking dictation. ScanSoft purchased my division of L&H in December 2001. 

I participated in the PDSay speech command recognizer for the Pocket PC, a desktop audio compression tool for use on the web, and a desktop TTS product.

See my website for a detailed resume.

positions.title: Senior Developer Support Rep.
positions.description:
Stream contracted technical support and helpdesk services to large companies among other things.

I took phone calls, helped others in the group with their issues and escalated issues that couldn't be solved.

See my website for a detailed resume.
